argument: At theta=pi/N, sin(x)<=x and pi^2<10 give g(pi/N)-g(0)<=the stated negative rational bound. Since g is even and g(pi)>g(0), compactness implies at least two symmetric global minimizers, irrespective of the numerical stationary-point census.
ENF_unique_scope: Outward radial ray in the local fitted-neighborhood; not the entire normal line
